notes.title: MAZAICA Is Out - Go and draw some lines!
notes.notes:
Hey fam,

Yup. After 5 years I've finally released new game. It's been a wild ride, but I hope you'll really enjoy this one!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1964420/MAZAICA/]Go MAZAICA on Steam[/url]

Have fun,
Cheers
Yours, Hamster

notes.title: Cards, Achievement, Linux and OS X support.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I just updated the game and added:
- Trading Cards!
- [b]Achievement[/b] for finishing the game.
- [b]Linux[/b] and [b]OS X[/b] support.
- Minor bug fixes, thanks for your help with finding them!

Thanks for the love.

And yeah, [b]Trading Cards[/b] should arrive within 1-2 days!
